conceptual_statement: Virginia’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is a statewide DPOR Class A/B/C contractor-license spine, separate DMV Household Goods certificates and Property Carrier permits with a 30-mile rule, DSS assisted-living licensing and inspection intelligence separate from CMS, a dated SCC mortgage-company roster that prints Virginia MC numbers and NMLS IDs, SCC insurance financial/action/exam evidence that is not a live authorized roster, and IAPD lenses that must not collapse into one adviser total. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /virginia pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /virginia is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate. Do not weaken the gate. No Virginia county or city routes.

intelligence_strip.grain: Distinct contractor-business LICENSE NUMBERS, not unique companies, not tradesmen, not all Virginia construction businesses. 30,120 tradesman/person rows stay a separate person grain.
Household Goods Carrier certificates. Not Property Carrier permits. Not a mover census. Do not add 192 + 4,916. State DMV authority is not USDOT, MC, or FMCSA interstate authority.
DSS Assisted Living licenses. Licensed capacity 38,010 is not occupancy. Adult Day 82 and CMS 289/237/110 stay separate classes. Do not add them into one Virginia senior-provider total.
Dated 2025 SCC company rows with exact VA-MC → NMLS bridges. Not a live September 2026 lender count. 24,222 MLO persons are not companies. HMDA applications are not lenders.
Dated financial/market evidence, year ended 2025-12-31, reported as of 2026-06-01. Not current authorization. 1,727 exact-match observations are not unique insurers.
APPROVED state IA firms. Not 339 principal-office firms, not 107 ERA, not 3,289 notice filings. 4,481 SCC annual activity is not 4,481 firms. Do not add these populations.

what_makes_virginia_different: Contractor: DPOR provides a strong statewide Class A/B/C contractor-license spine, plus tradesmen as a separate person grain.
Move: Virginia DMV has separate Household Goods Carrier certificates and Property Carrier permits, with an important 30-mile rule. Interstate authority remains FMCSA.
Senior: Virginia DSS gives unusually rich assisted-living licensing and inspection intelligence separate from CMS nursing/home-health/hospice.
Lender: The dated SCC mortgage-company roster prints both Virginia MC numbers and NMLS IDs, providing strong exact identity bridges. Live 2026 company denominator remains unknown.
Insurance: SCC provides dated financial/company observations plus bounded Regulatory Action and Market Conduct tables using NAIC identities. That is not a live authorized-insurer universe.
Investor: IAPD exposes separate Virginia state IA, ERA, notice-filing, and principal-office lenses; these cannot be collapsed into one adviser total.

contractor.grain_note: 53,840 is distinct Class A/B/C contractor-business LICENSE NUMBERS, not unique companies. 120 revocation observations / 119 cases / 100 license IDs stay evidence.

move.grain_note: 5,108 listing/credential rows != 5,106 distinct non-null authority identities. 192 is HHG certificate identities. 4,914 is Property Carrier authority identities. Do not treat 192 as all Virginia Move state identities. Authority 1276 is SOURCE_IDENTIFIER_CONFLICT.

senior.grain_note: ALF and Adult Day remain separate source classes. Do not add 573 + 82 as Virginia senior providers. No derived combined facility denominator.

lender.grain_note: 1,257 dated SCC company rows with exact VA-MC → NMLS bridges. Not 1,257 current lenders and not 1,257 new canonical lenders. Canonical state identity is VA-SCC-BFI:{MC}.

investor.grain_note: 807 = 700 state-IA identities + 107 state-ERA identities. TERMREQUEST = 3. State IA ∩ ERA = 0. 697 is APPROVED current state-RIA, not the complete state identity ledger. Not 807 advisers, current RIAs, or public profiles.

insurance.grain_note: Observation growth, not a current authorized-insurer identity universe. 1,546 dated statistical-report observations. 1,727 exact-match observations are not unique insurers.

CROSS_HUB_RECORD_TOTAL.explanation: Contractor licenses, mover authorities, senior facilities/inspections, HMDA applications, mortgage companies, insurance observations, adviser registrations, and regulatory cases are incompatible grains. Ask does not publish a Virginia-records total.

NEW_PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SURFACES.explanation: Six specialist /virginia pages plus Ask /virginia. Page/surface count only — not a business, record, provider, or license count.
